sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text:
- The mask causes Shadow of Tagilla to resemble Minotaur, the creature living in the Labyrinth, from Greek mythology.
- In the Russian localization, "ZABEY" is spelled "ЗАБЕЙ", which is an imperative word meaning "to slaughter" (among other possible meanings).
